description: stratagemCanTarget(stratagem, keywords): whether a unit with these lower-cased keywords (the combined unit's, as the resolver collects them) can be the stratagem's friendly target. A Warlord target needs a unit that could contain the Warlord: one with CHARACTER.

cases.name: warlord target: a CHARACTER unit with the required keyword qualifies
warlord target: a unit with no CHARACTER cannot contain the Warlord
warlord target: the keyword lists still apply to the Warlord's unit
warlord target with no keywords: any CHARACTER unit
several targets: the non-Warlord target admits a unit the Warlord target refuses
no Warlord requirement: a unit with no CHARACTER qualifies
